data.name: Pundarik
data.gender_notes: Pundarik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has a lotus as his crest, a symbol of purity and enlightenment. The name Pundarik carries the meaning “Lotus Flower” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pundarik usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and the attainment of self-realization.
data.etymology: Pundarik belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus Flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pundarik total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_sanskrit.name: पुन्दरिक
